fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: ClientInstanceId
fields.about: Assigned client instance id if ClientInstanceId was 0 in the request, else 0.

fields.name: SubscriptionId
fields.about: Unique identifier for the current subscription set for this client instance.

fields.name: AcceptedCompressionTypes
fields.about: Compression types that broker accepts for the PushTelemetryRequest.

fields.name: PushIntervalMs
fields.about: Configured push interval, which is the lowest configured interval in the current subscription set.

fields.name: TelemetryMaxBytes
fields.about: The maximum bytes of binary data the broker accepts in PushTelemetryRequest.

fields.name: DeltaTemporality
fields.about: Flag to indicate monotonic/counter metrics are to be emitted as deltas or cumulative values.

fields.name: RequestedMetrics
fields.about: Requested metrics prefix string match. Empty array: No metrics subscribed, Array[0] empty string: All metrics subscribed.
